compat_notes: Import path: the import URL builds the DEFAULT branch (master). So the PR targets DeadSpace; the badge and Staticfile reach master when the maintainer merges the 1.5 release into master. Until then, importing master without the Staticfile gives provider node with a failing build. Patch applies cleanly to both DeadSpace and master (git apply --check), and master+patch was verified (plan staticfile, replay and SWS smoke pass), so the maintainer could also take it on master. The patch has no generated JS/CSS (README.md + Staticfile only), as the README requires.

caveats: Whole repository root is served (src/, package.json, Dockerfile, cors_server.py, debug.html, debug-console.html are publicly reachable; debug.html is a client-side debug page). Google Analytics tag <analytics-tag> (the owner's) is in index.html, wiki.html and save.html; forks should change or remove it (stated in the README text). Third-party runtime requests: unpkg.com (Vue, Buefy, Popper, Sortable, Chart.js), fonts.googleapis.com (Lato), googletagmanager.com, and a periodic version check fetch of https://pmotschmann.github.io/Evolve/package.json (shows 'update available' when versions differ). Saves are kept in browser localStorage per host (stated in the README with Export/Import guidance). MPL-2.0 obligations for modified forks. Default-branch timing caveat above. No forms, auth, payments or secrets.
policy: Read README 'Submitting Issues' / 'Contributing' sections: bug fixes, translations, themes or UI improvements may be submitted directly as PRs; features must not simply make the game easier; 'All pull requests should be based off current dev branch. The dev branch is either master or named after its version number. Please check the current game version and what branches are available'; 'Pull requests should not contain the JS/CSS files generated by the build.' Verified: branches are master, DeadSpace, and dependabot/*; no branch named 'dev' (research claim of a 'dev' branch is wrong in name; the active dev branch is DeadSpace, v1.5.0, not version-named, but clearly the one PRs target). No CONTRIBUTING, AGENTS.md, AI policy, PR template or .github dir. No issue-first requirement. Deploy-provider stance: the maintainer merged an outside 'Add dockerfile' PR (#1169, 2024-11) and closed a second Dockerfile PR (#1222, 2025-04); outside PRs proposing to stop committing generated files (#1055 closed, #1064/#1181 still open) were not adopted, i.e. the maintainer keeps committed builds, which is what the Staticfile relies on. No hosting-provider buttons or provider PRs. Outside merges: frequent (e.g. #1528 2026-08-01 to master; #1631-#1638 Sep-Oct 2026 to DeadSpace).

why: 1264-star, actively developed incremental game whose maintainer keeps the built game committed in the repository and documents self-hosting (gh-pages fork deploy, Docker). That makes it servable as plain static files with no build, which the Staticfile states explicitly; without it, Anybuild picks a Node server with a broken start command. The README text also tells self-hosters the two things that differ from the official site: the owner's analytics ID and per-host browser saves (with the existing Export/Import).
